scenes.title: PA & TA Application Automation
scenes.caption: One portal for Professional and Teaching Assistantships
scenes.narration: Professional and Teaching Assistant recruitment involves applications, academic checks, reviews, and final lists. Manual coordination makes this process harder to manage.

scenes.title: From manual coordination to a shared workflow
scenes.caption: Configure → Apply → Review → Approve → Export
scenes.narration: Our solution brings the complete workflow into one portal, from generated application forms to approved results.

scenes.title: Three workspaces. One application cycle.
scenes.caption: Admin configures and approves · Students apply · Faculty selects
scenes.narration: Administrators configure and approve. Students apply and track progress. Faculty review candidates for their assigned courses.

scenes.title: Monitor the active semester
scenes.caption: Live application counts, allocated positions, and vacancies
scenes.narration: The Admin dashboard shows the active semester, application counts, filled positions, and vacancies.

scenes.title: Configure positions and application dates
scenes.caption: Separate PA/TA slots and amounts, with one application window
scenes.narration: Admin sets course slots, assistantship amounts, application dates, and course-head assignments.

scenes.title: Publish eligibility to generate forms
scenes.caption: Year, CGPA, course grade, and interview rules drive eligibility
scenes.narration: Publishing year, C G P A, grade, and interview rules generates the opportunities and forms.

scenes.title: Start with the academic profile
scenes.caption: Academic information is preloaded and read-only
scenes.narration: The student starts with a preloaded academic profile, reducing repeated data entry.

scenes.title: Discover eligible PA and TA opportunities
scenes.caption: Availability, requirements, amount, and eligibility appear together
scenes.narration: Opportunities show eligibility, available positions, requirements, and assistantship amounts. The backend rechecks eligibility before submission.

scenes.title: Submit a prefilled application
scenes.caption: An optional statement adds context without retyping academics
scenes.narration: This form already contains academic details. The student only adds an optional statement.

scenes.title: Track multiple applications
scenes.caption: Two PA applications and one TA application submitted successfully
scenes.narration: Here, two P A applications and one T A application are submitted and tracked separately.

scenes.title: Faculty access follows course assignments
scenes.caption: Only the assigned active-semester course is visible
scenes.narration: Faculty can access only their assigned active-semester course. Let us follow the review process.

scenes.title: Review the submitted academic snapshot
scenes.caption: Academics, statement, timetable, and private review notes
scenes.narration: Faculty inspect the submitted academics, statement, and timetable. Private notes support their review.

scenes.title: Shortlist and select within capacity
scenes.caption: Shortlisted → Selected pending acceptance → Accepted
scenes.narration: The candidate is shortlisted and selected. Capacity checks prevent the course from being overfilled.

scenes.title: Accept the PA appointment
scenes.caption: Appointment created; remaining same-role applications close automatically
scenes.narration: Accepting the P A appointment automatically cancels other pending applications for the same role.

scenes.title: Follow the required TA interview branch
scenes.caption: Synthetic rehearsal: schedule an interview in Dubai time
scenes.narration: For the interview-required T A role, faculty schedule an interview with its time and location.

scenes.title: Record evaluation before TA selection
scenes.caption: Demo evaluation required before selecting and accepting the TA
scenes.narration: An evaluation must be recorded before selection. The T A appointment is then accepted.

scenes.title: Submit both appointments to Admin
scenes.caption: One PA and one TA are permitted; both require final approval
scenes.narration: One student may hold one P A and one T A. Faculty submit both appointments to Admin.

scenes.title: Review submissions and finalize
scenes.caption: Admin checks submitted appointments, capacity, and conflicts
scenes.narration: Admin reviews submitted appointments and conflicts, then finalizes the semester, locking the approved results.

scenes.title: Automatically generate the final selected list
scenes.caption: Approved PA/TA results · Verified Excel and PDF downloads
scenes.narration: The final selected list is generated automatically and can be downloaded as Excel or P D F.

scenes.title: See automatic cancellation and accepted roles
scenes.caption: Other PA auto-cancelled · Accepted PA and TA retained
scenes.narration: The student can see the other P A application automatically cancelled, with both accepted roles retained.

scenes.title: View personal approved results
scenes.caption: Only the signed-in student's approved results are shown
scenes.narration: Personal final results show only that student's approved appointments and amounts.

scenes.title: A full-stack system with server-enforced rules
scenes.caption: React + Express + PostgreSQL · Transactions · Revocable sessions
scenes.narration: React and Vite provide the frontend. Express enforces access and workflow rules. PostgreSQL transactions protect appointments; local mode uses P G Lite.

scenes.title: University integration with a defined contract
scenes.caption: RS256 intranet assertions · Academic sync · Live connection pending
scenes.narration: Revocable sessions protect access. An optional signed intranet interface supports institutional identity and academic synchronization.

scenes.title: Less coordination. Clearer decisions.
scenes.caption: Expected impact: less data entry, organized reviews, auditable results
scenes.narration: The expected impact is less manual entry, organized reviews, clearer status tracking, and auditable final lists.

scenes.title: Ready to demonstrate. Next: university rollout.
scenes.caption: Synthetic demo · Real SSO and production hosting remain to configure
scenes.narration: This demonstration uses synthetic data. Real university sign-in and production hosting remain to configure; duty timetable-overlap detection is a future extension.
